metric: sum(abs(reference RGB - candidate RGB)) / (255 * channel count), on fixed static ROI
roi_selection: Record before first candidate render; no post-hoc resizing, fitted alignment, or ROI/mask changes
mutation_requirement: Each new value alone must strictly worsen original screenshot error; restore and compare file bytes before next mutation
scope: Camera comparison only; no whole-renderer fidelity claim from a camera-only fixture
failure_to_obtain_comparison: A1 remains incomplete; no camera values promoted to docs or rules
